rachats.citation: In September 2023, Oneok acquired Magellan Midstream Partners for $18.8 billion.
ONEOK acquired Medallion Midstream, a crude oil gathering and transportation company and a controlling stake in EnLink Midstream.
In February 2025, the company completed acquisition of the remaining shares in EnLink Midstream.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
